summary: Fixed the R02 residual findings (R02-QA-01..05) and completed the C1-RV-02 security verification gate on build cce8db1 with genuine RED->GREEN tests at API/PostgreSQL/WS and React-container seams. Rejected receipts now read back stably, deduplicated keys are bound to a stable fingerprint/outcome, writes recheck authorization under the mutation transaction (controlled blocked-write vs revoke/expiry), the uncertain join keeps its immutable payload and shows the stored label, participant state is one repeatable-read snapshot with equal-revision reconciliation, and the WS sweep/authorization boundary is testable. Current-build regression: Mode A 84 pass / 0 fail; Mode B rebuilt Docker-only stack and a separate Docker runner 84 pass / 0 fail; restarts keep data. Real-browser flows remain NOT RUN (no browser automation); C1-15 stays PARTIAL.
commits: cce8db1 fix(c1): stable rejected receipts, atomic write authorization and coherent participant state

findings.notes: Receipt GET returns the stored terminal rejection (200, terminal/replay true) after a lost ack, inside session-end grace, and 401 after revoke.
Deduplicated new key stores an accepted receipt bound to the response and its fingerprint; replay stable, changed payload 409, one response row.
Grant re-read FOR UPDATE inside the mutation transaction; controlled session-lock blocked writes rejected 401 after revoke or expiry with no row/receipt; facilitator control variant included.
Immutable pending join payload; nickname edit not sent; server-stored label displayed. Real-browser retest NOT RUN.

One repeatable-read participant snapshot for /api/me, join and WS state; equal-revision reconciliation. Deterministic mid-read commit interleaving NOT achieved without production hooks; stress test and structure only.
Configurable idle sweep, exact 1s grace boundary, hard TTL resync, revoke-vs-broadcast; per-socket revalidation documented as the authorization/send linearization boundary; no zero-race claim.
